lead.en: Khlong San wraps four khwaeng of west-bank sois, temples and piers around the Charoen Nakhon riverfront, where ICONSIAM (opened 2018, revenues up to 5.4bn THB in 2024) sets the register for everything from rents to dining. Transit is unusually deep for the west bank - the Gold Line's Khlong San terminus at Taksin Hospital, BTS Silom stops, express boats and 11+ mapped piers - while public green is thin (5.3 ha, 0.9%). The 2021 loss of the 40-year Khlong San Plaza market to an SRT rent dispute marked the turn from market-khet to tower-khet; registered population has fallen to 64,961.

strengths.en: Transit depth without a rail-hub address: a Gold Line terminus at Taksin Hospital, BTS Silom stops at both ends of the khet, two bridges and a dense pier layer for river commuting.

tradeoffs.en: Green 7 is buffer-dependent: the khet holds just 5.3 ha of park (0.9% share), the riverside 'park' is private mall ground, and the named public parks sit at polygon edges.
The everyday-market layer lost its 40-year anchor when Khlong San Plaza closed in 2021 over an SRT rent jump (1.6M -> 15M THB), and no replacement development is confirmed.

dayNight.en: Mornings run on hospital, school and ferry commutes; ICONSIAM's evenings and weekends draw the crowds the sois never see; after midnight the khet is residential again - the Gold Line and mall both shut early.

fit.en: Choose it if you want river-adjacent living with real transit (Gold Line + BTS + boats) at rents starting around 15k for studios and ~42-44k for 2-beds near the water - and can live with pocket-scale parks.
Skip it if you need actual park acreage or a cheap everyday-market street: at 0.9% park share and with the plaza market gone, the green and market stories are the khet's weakest.

uncertainties: Unresolved: ICONSIAM's polygon membership vs its khwaeng Wat Kanlaya address; the 5.3-ha park counting rule; pier-count rule (OSM shows 11+ named terminals); status of the former plaza plot; safety 7 rests on no located statistics.

limitations: app khlong-san polygon is too coarse to contain most of these points (only G3 + Talat Tha Din Daeng PIP-IN); coordinator polygon audit recommended
